### Send us a Message

```{=html}
<form action="[https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID](https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID)" method="POST">
  <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <label for="name" style="display: block; margin-bottom: 5px;"><strong>Name</strong></label>
    <input type="text" id="name" name="name" required style="width: 100%; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box;">
  </div>

  <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <label for="email" style="display: block; margin-bottom: 5px;"><strong>Email</strong></label>
    <input type="email" id="email" name="email" required style="width: 100%; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box;">
  </div>

  <div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
    <label for="message" style="display: block; margin-bottom: 5px;"><strong>Message</strong></label>
    <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="5" required style="width: 100%; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box;"></textarea>
  </div>

  <button type="submit" style="background-color: #007bff; color: white; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">Send Message</button>
</form>
```
